default.title: Imora Servicios S.L.
default.description: Full-service facility management company for businesses, homeowner communities, buildings and shopping centres in Madrid.
default.keywords: Imora, services for businesses and communities, concierge, security, cleaning, maintenance

/.title: Concierge, security, cleaning and maintenance for businesses and communities
/.description: Imora manages concierge, security, cleaning, pools and maintenance for businesses, communities and buildings in Madrid, with our own team and 24-hour support.
/.keywords: concierge Madrid, services for businesses, facility management company, building maintenance, security and CCTV, community and shopping centre cleaning

/services.title: Our services for businesses, communities and buildings
/services.description: Concierge, security, pool maintenance, cleaning and gardening, and building maintenance: five specialised services for businesses, communities and shopping centres, from a single provider.
/services.keywords: services for businesses and homeowner communities, concierge, security CCTV, pool maintenance, cleaning and gardening, building maintenance

/services/concierge.title: Concierge and access control for your building
/services/concierge.description: Reception, access control and mail handling with 6 to 24-hour shifts, for communities, buildings and businesses, with guaranteed cover for sick leave and holidays.
/services/concierge.keywords: concierge for communities and businesses, access control, Madrid concierge, building doorman

/services/security.title: Security and CCTV for buildings, businesses and communities
/services/security.description: Design, installation and maintenance of video surveillance and electronic access control to protect your building, business or shopping centre.
/services/security.keywords: security and CCTV for businesses, community video surveillance, electronic access control, camera installation Madrid

/services/pools.title: Community pool maintenance
/services/pools.description: Water chemical maintenance, pool cleaning and qualified lifeguards throughout the swimming season, following Spanish pool regulations.
/services/pools.keywords: pool maintenance, community pool lifeguards, pool cleaning Madrid, pool season opening and closing

/services/cleaning.title: Cleaning and gardening for communities and businesses
/services/cleaning.description: Cleaning of the entrance, stairs and garage, and upkeep of gardens and green areas, at whatever frequency each community, building or business needs.
/services/cleaning.keywords: cleaning for communities and businesses, common area cleaning, gardening for communities, building entrance cleaning Madrid

/services/maintenance.title: Building and business maintenance: plumbing, electrics and locksmithing
/services/maintenance.description: In-house technical team for plumbing, electrics, locksmithing and small works in buildings, communities and businesses, with a fast response to faults.
/services/maintenance.keywords: building and business maintenance, community plumbing, common area electrics, emergency locksmith, technical maintenance Madrid

/about.title: About Imora: our own team and 24-hour support
/about.description: How we work: our own team, an inspection department, ISO certifications and coverage for businesses, communities and buildings across Madrid and its metropolitan area.
/about.keywords: facility management company Madrid, services for businesses and communities, in-house concierge team, ISO 9001 certification, 24-hour support

/contact.title: Contact Imora
/contact.description: Write to us, call us or visit us: we reply within 24 hours to resolve any question about our services.
/contact.keywords: contact facility management company, homeowner community quote, Imora phone number, Imora Madrid office
